sharedSub: $5 per rider · leaves at {n} riders or in {m} min
note: Daytime fare. Paid by card in the app.
exploreSub: Book local guides, rentals and essentials.
schedSub: Plan around the crowds and your flight.
demo: Demo data. The live app pulls port and airport feeds.
hi: Hi! I'm Isla. Ask me about water taxis, tours, or what to do today.
chips: How late do water taxis run?
Best snorkel spot near West Bay?
Is a cruise ship in today?
offline: The assistant isn't available in this view. In the live app it answers here.
wet: Coming off a snorkel tour (bring towels)
waits: Your captain waits at the pier 5 min early.
feeNote: Scheduled pickups are a private boat for your group, plus a $5 reservation fee.
pnote: Prices were last checked online and can change. Confirm when you request.
demoPay: Demo checkout. No card is charged.
lock: The operator's WhatsApp is shared only after your booking is paid.
quoteHint: The operator sends a price in the app. You pay here, then their WhatsApp unlocks.
fromHint: *Starting price. The operator confirms the final amount.
cardErr: Check the card details: name, number, MM/YY and CVC.
reqSentSub: You'll get the price here. Contact unlocks after payment.
captainLine: Your captain is heading to the dock.
waDemo: WhatsApp number appears here once the operator joins the app.
waDemoTap: Demo: this opens a WhatsApp chat with the operator.
outside: You're outside Roatán, so the map shows West End.
demoBoats: Demo boats. Live positions will come from captains' phones.
mileNote: Distance fare: $5 per person per mile.
noTaxi: No free boat nearby right now
nearWE: Nearest to West End first. Tap Near me on the map to sort by your location.
infoNote: Info only, no booking. Distances are approximate; call ahead to check hours.
sosS: Call 911 first, then go to the nearest 24/7 facility.
trips_empty: No trips yet. Book a water taxi or a tour and it shows up here.
demoMode: Demo mode: no server connected. Boats are simulated and nothing is charged.
requestNote: We confirm price and availability with the operator before you pay.
onlineNow: You're online. Guests can see your boat.
bgLocNote: Your position is shared only while you're online, even with the screen off.
locDenied: Location permission is off. Turn it on in Settings to go online.
payNotReady: Card payments are not connected yet. In demo mode, tapping Pay simulates a payment.
giveS: Support kids with special needs on the island.
assistantErr: The assistant couldn't answer. Try again in a moment.
callAhead: We don't see live stock. Call ahead to make sure they have it.
noResults: Nothing found. Try another word, or ask Isla.
goRide: Looking for a water taxi? Book it on the Ride tab.
seaChoppyMsg: Choppy on this route. Expect some spray; sit toward the back.
seaRoughMsg: Rough water on this route. Boats won't run it; take a land taxi or move plans to the calm side.
seaUnknownMsg: No captain report in the last 3 hours.
nightMsg: After dark we only send boats with running lights, to the dock you choose. Never walk the beach between West End and West Bay at night.
closedMsg: Boats stop at {h}. Take a land taxi instead.
shareMsg: Send family a live link to your boat.
noShared: No shared boat yet. Yours leaves when {n} riders join or in {m} min.
joinedBoat: Joining the boat leaving in {m} min
passPromo: Staying a week? Unlimited West End ↔ West Bay rides for ${p}.
passIntro: Pay once, ride all week. No cash, no waiting to fill a boat.
passOnlyZone: Covers West End ↔ West Bay rides. Longer routes are paid per mile.
repeatHint: Same time each day, for your whole stay. Pause anytime.
guaranteeMsg: Your captain confirms 15 min before. If not, we send another boat. Miss you by 10 min and you get a ${c} credit.
g_scheduled: Booked. Your captain confirms 15 min before pickup.
g_confirmed: Captain confirmed and on the way
g_missed: We missed your pickup. Credit added to your account.
addTaxi: Add a water taxi there and back
noDockNear: No dock near this place. Ask Isla for a land taxi.
noPlaces: Save your rental or dive shop for one-tap rides.
confirmBy: Tap On my way at least {m} min before pickup or the ride goes to another boat.
confirmNow: Confirm now. The guest is waiting for your answer.
sameDock: You're already at this dock. No boat needed.
pickShipSub: We'll only show what gets you back before all-aboard.
islandTimeNote: All times are Roatán island time. Your ship may use a different clock: check your ship's daily planner.
missesPort: Too long for your port time
fitUnknown: We don't know the drive time to this place yet. The operator confirms timing for your ship.
noTimeFits: No start time gets you back before all-aboard. Pick a shorter trip or one closer to the port.
backInTime: Back at the port by {t}, with {m} min to spare.
tooSoon: That time is too soon. Pick a later time.
meetAskOperator: The operator sends the exact meeting spot in {area} on WhatsApp after you book.
taxiFromPort: Taxi from your port: about {m} min.
meetPort_mahogany: Walk out of the Mahogany Bay port gate to the tour and taxi area. Your guide holds an orange Water Uber sign.
meetPort_coxen: Exit the Port of Roatán (Town Center) gate to the tour pickup lot. Your guide holds an orange Water Uber sign.
crowdTip_quiet: Great day for West Bay beach.
crowdTip_busy: West Bay fills up 10 am–2 pm. Go early or after 3.
crowdTip_very_busy: Beaches and snorkel spots will be crowded. Try West End, Sandy Bay or an early boat trip.
crowdTip_packed: The busiest kind of day. Book early starts and skip West Bay at midday.
splitHint: Everyone pays their own share by link. No app needed.
splitRule: Your spot is held until everyone pays, up to {m} min before the start. If not, the booking is cancelled and everyone is refunded automatically.
splitNoTaxi: Water taxi add-on isn't available with split payments.
splitExpired: Not everyone paid in time. The booking was cancelled and payments are being refunded.
splitShareMsg: Join me for {name}! Pay your share ({p}) here, no app needed: {url}
splitInvite: You're invited to a group trip
splitPrivacy: Names and contact details of the group are never shown here.
splitNotFound: This group link isn't valid anymore.
splitFull: Every share is already paid or being paid.
tooLateSplit: Too close to the start to split. Pay in full instead.
missesShip: That time could make you miss your ship. Pick an earlier start.
securePay: Paid on our processor's secure page. We never see your card number.
payFailed: The payment didn't go through. Try again or use another card.
confirmingPaySub: This usually takes a few seconds. You can leave this screen; your trip updates on its own.
payPendingNote: We haven't heard from the bank yet. Check Trips in a minute; you won't be charged twice.
taxiWithQuote: Your water taxi is reserved and is paid together with the tour once the operator sends the price.
ticketMissing: This ticket isn't saved on this phone yet. Open it once with signal.
ticketTip: Tip: take a screenshot too, in case your phone restarts.
offlineNote: You're offline. Your tickets still work.
scanToBook: Scan to book. No app download needed.
priorityExplain: Priority is only for safety and trip alerts: rough water, schedule changes, your ship's deadline or a cancelled booking. Never ads.
inboxEmpty_all: Offers, updates and trip alerts will show up here.
inboxEmpty_offer: No offers right now. Check back on busy ship days.
inboxEmpty_support: Messages from our team about your trips show up here.
inboxEmpty_update: Tickets, refunds and credits show up here.
composeDemo: Demo: messages you send stay on this phone. In the live app only admins can send, and every guest sees them.
inboxSendFail: Couldn't send. Check you're signed in as admin.
noPromoPriority: Promotions can't go in Priority. Use Offers; Priority is for safety and trip alerts.
composeNote: Guests see it in the Inbox tab right away. Write in English; add other languages in the database (translations) if you want.
giveCardS: 10% of what this app earns goes to Roatán kids. Add a donation.
giveMission: Support for kids with special needs on Roatán and their families. Your gift helps build Mangrove House, a place on the island where they can get care, learn and play.
givePledge: {p}% of what this app earns goes to Roatán kids.
giveHowBody: "Earnings" means the part of each booking the app keeps after paying captains and tour operators. Every month we hand {p}% of it to the charity, plus 100% of guest donations, and the total given shows on this page.
giveGiven: handed to the charity so far
giveWebNote: Opens our secure website in your browser to complete the donation.
giveThanksSub: Your donation goes to {name}. A receipt is on its way to your email.
giveFull: 100% of your donation goes to the charity. We cover the card fees.
giveTax: Donations may not be tax-deductible where you live.
